application: scripts/depthn_screen_amended_verdict.py, with the amendment and both earlier files by sha256
computed_before: Only the screen latency rule (CONTINUE: 0 timeouts in the first 1,000 searched decisions), fairness checkpoint 1 (50 pairs, no flag) and a descriptive re-stratification of Foul Play's iteration rates had been computed; none carries outcomes. No paired, score or outcome statistic of this run had been computed.
decided_by: the lead (search, V2, CUDA), on the Opus review's finding that an imputed interval alone can be harsher or easier than the declared estimator

rule.bar: bar met = the known-pairs interval's lower bound > 0 AND the conservative interval's lower bound > 0 (both), with no amended breakage, at the 2,000-cell verdict; the screen continues only without harm (as above) and without amended breakage
rule.harm: harm = the known-pairs interval's upper bound < 0 AND the mirror interval's upper bound < 0 (both)
rule.principle: the amendment can only add robustness to unknowns; it never makes a claim easier than the declared estimator
